identity.name: Bubba Gump Performance Hub
principles: No Boring Corporate UI: If it looks like Excel, burn it.
Texture is King: Use wood, paper, and net textures to kill the digital flatness.
Storytelling: Every review is a story, not just a stat.
Warmth over Coolness: Use warm lights, wood tones, and friendly colors.

headings.usage: All section titles, card headers, and big stats. Gives that 'Storybook' or 'Old Sign' feel.

body.usage: Data tables, long text, inputs. Keep it legible but friendly.

accents.usage: Quotes, 'Run Forrest Run' references, empty states.

textures.wood_grain: Use subtle wood grain patterns for sidebars or headers.
textures.paper_texture: Use a noise/grain overlay on cards to make them feel like physical menu items.
textures.fishing_net: Use net patterns for drag-and-drop zones.

layout.spacing: Generous (p-6 to p-12). Don't cram the shrimp.

motion.loading: Spinning ship wheel or jumping shrimp

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-primary/90 hover:scale-105 transition-all font-serif font-bold tracking-wide
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-secondary text-secondary rounded-full hover:bg-secondary hover:text-white transition-all font-medium

cards.style: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-xl border border-border shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden
cards.variant_menu: Rotate slightly (-1deg or 1deg) on hover. Add a 'tape' visual at the top center.

inputs.style: bg-background border-2 border-input rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 transition-all

backgrounds.description: Dark rustic wood texture for sidebars or dark mode backgrounds
Fishing net texture for upload zones or subtle overlays
Tropical pier sunset for login screens or hero headers

decorative.description: Shrimp dish for 'Top Performer' rewards or food references

icons.style: Stroke width 2px, rounded corners. Use nautical icons where possible (Anchor, Ship, Fish, Waves).

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building the 'Bubba Gump Performance Hub'. It must feel like a fun, well-loved tool used by restaurant managers at the pier. Avoid sterile corporate aesthetics. Use the provided textures and colors to create warmth.
specific_tasks: Implement the 'Bento Grid' layout for the Dashboard.
Create a 'File Upload' component that looks like a fishing net catching the file.
Design the 'Employee Review' PDF generation flow to look like printing a special menu.
Use the 'Merriweather' font for all headings to maintain the brand voice.
Ensure the 'Dark/Light' toggle switches between 'Day at the Pier' and 'Night at the Shack'.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
